subject: Future Tech
title: From Ink to Objects
description: Learn From Ink to Objects in one minute.

hook.text: What if you could print a wrench the same way you print a document?

buildup.text: A 3D printer builds objects layer by layer, stacking thin slices of material until a complete shape emerges.

discovery.text: Chuck Hull invented stereolithography in 1984—the first 3D print method—using UV light to harden resin layer by layer.

twist.text: Hull's invention took 40 years to go mainstream. Today a desktop 3D printer costs less than a smartphone.

climax.text: 3D printing now makes everything from jet engine parts to human organs.

punchline.text: Manufacturing used to subtract. Now it adds, one layer at a time.

quiz.question: Who invented the first 3D printing method?
